name: ai-engineering-os
description: Codex engineering governance layer: three stateless gates, approvals, worktree isolation, and lightweight memory.

interface.shortDescription: Governance layer for Codex: start/frontend/finish gates, worktrees, memory.
interface.longDescription: Answers whether engineering work is allowed and why at task start, frontend implementation, and finish; isolates parallel work in disposable worktrees; keeps durable project memory. Never replaces Codex's native engineering capabilities.
defaultPrompt: Run a governance start check for my task.
Set up a disposable worktree for parallel work.
Check whether this task may finish.
